jobs.description:
We are Team possible – the people behind Codit, Proximus, Proximus NXT, Davinsi Labs, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here! 
United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world.  
That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do.  
Sounds like your kind of place? 

Your job 

At Codit, we help organizations build and run digital solutions using Microsoft technology. 

We are looking for an Azure Infrastructure Architect with strong pre-sales focus to play a key role in:

• Designing, implementing, and evolving secure, scalable, and automated cloud environments for a diverse range of projects.
• Building trusted partnerships with customers, including C‑level leaders, by delivering clear, compelling technical insights and translating them into concrete solution architectures and actionable proposals. 
You’ll be a technical leader and trusted advisor with strong communication skills, combining hands-on expertise with customer-facing impact, helping Codit and our clients accelerate their cloud journeys through well-architected Azure platforms and landing zone solutions. 

Key Responsibilities 

What You’ll Do

• Lead technical pre-sales engagements (workshops, proposals, estimations, solution shaping)
• Translate customer challenges into solution architectures and commercial proposals
• Support account teams in deal positioning and closure
• Architect, design, and implement Azure platforms aligned with best practices.
• Lead the customization and modularization of Azure cloud infrastructure components to fit each client’s scale, security, and operational maturity.
• Define and enforce cloud governance, security, and compliance standards
• Automate infrastructure deployment using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Bicep, ARM, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (developers, operations, and business stakeholders) to deliver robust, future-proof solutions.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to colleagues and contribute to internal knowledge sharing sessions.
• Stay up to date with Azure innovations, continuously improving Codit’s offerings. 

What You Bring

• Proven experience designing and deploying Azure infrastructure at scale
• Act as a trusted advisor to executive leadership by translating technical realities into meaningful business insights and guiding decision‑makers with authority and credibility.
• Strong knowledge of Azure core services: networking, identity management, security, monitoring, and automation.
• Hands-on expertise with Infrastructure-as-Code (Bicep, ARM, Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
• Experience with cloud governance, cost management, and compliance in regulated environments.
• Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, or equivalent) are highly valued.
• Excellent communication skills in English and Dutch (French is a plus).
• A proactive, problem-solving mindset: you love a challenge and aren’t afraid to take initiative.
• A collaborative spirit and a sense of humor! 
Bonus Points

• Broad experience across the Microsoft Azure ecosystem (infrastructure, data, integration, and application services)
• Experience with multi-cloud, hybrid architectures or Sovereign solutions.
• Previous consulting or managed services experience.

We are Team possible – the people behind Codit, Proximus, Proximus NXT, Davinsi Labs, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here! 
United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world.  
That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do.  
Sounds like your kind of place? 

Your job 

As Domain Lead Integration, you are accountable for presales, technical delivery excellence and domain growth within Codit's Integration domain.

You combine deep expertise in Azure Integration Services and enterprise integration with strong leadership and customer-facing skills. You act as a trusted advisor for customers, a mentor for colleagues and a technical leader within Codit. 

Your responsibilities

• Lead technical pre-sales activities including workshops, assessments, estimations, PoCs, demos and solution shaping.
• Translate customer challenges into solution architectures, technical proposals and delivery approaches.
• Support account teams in opportunity development, positioning and closure.
• Define and evolve Codit's Integration vision, reference architectures and best practices.
• Ensure solutions are architected according to best practices for security, scalability, maintainability and observability.
• Guide architects and delivery teams on complex integration engagements.
• Align customer roadmaps with Codit's delivery and operational capabilities.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, Microsoft and strategic partners.
• Share knowledge, coach colleagues and drive competency growth within the Integration domain.
• Contribute to marketing initiatives, events and community activities.
• Take up billable architecture activities where appropriate. 

About You

You have:

• Minimum 10 years of experience in integration and cloud architecture.
• Strong expertise in Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, Azure Functions).
• Knowledge of integration patterns, API-led architectures, event-driven architectures and hybrid integration.
• Experience leading workshops, solution assessments and technical pre-sales engagements.
• Strong communication and presentation skills in both Dutch and English, towards technical and business stakeholders.
• The ability to align technical strategy with customer and business objectives.
• A coaching mindset and a passion for knowledge sharing.
• An entrepreneurial mindset with a strong customer focus.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Third Party Risk Management Expert - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

As a Third-Party Technology Risk Management (TPTRM) Expert in our CoE Security - Governance, Risk & Compliance team, you will assess, evaluate and monitor IT and cybersecurity risks related to intragroup and external suppliers. Join our Brussels-based team of 10 specialists, where you will collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure robust risk management in a dynamic environment.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Conduct comprehensive IT and cyber risk assessments of third-party suppliers (intragroup and external) and cloud-based solutions to evaluate their cybersecurity posture, IT controls, and compliance with regulatory requirements.
• Review, challenge, negotiate, and embed IT and cybersecurity clauses in supplier contracts, collaborating with Procurement, Legal, and Business teams.
• Coordinate onsite audits, validate findings, and drive remediation plans with third parties, escalating critical risks to stakeholders.
• Track third-party security posture through periodic reviews (vulnerability reports, incident responses, compliance attestations) and synthesize risks for senior management via dashboards.
• Enhance TPTRM methodologies, tools, and templates (e.g., risk assessment questionnaires, audit guidelines) to reflect emerging threats and regulatory changes.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• You are an expert in cybersecurity, risk management, and compliance, including deep knowledge of cyber threats, frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC, NIST, OWASP), and you are able to provide expert security guidance.
• You have 10+ years of experience in IT & Cyber Risk Management with a strong focus on third-party technical security risk assessments,  supplier/vendor evaluations, audit methodologies and cloud security (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS).
• You have contractual and IT security review skills, including experience in reviewing and amending IT and cybersecurity clauses in contracts.
• You have some experience in process design and business analysis, particularly in IT and security risk management.
• You have worked in the Financial services industry, particularly in large corporate environments, with a focus on IT and security risk management.
• You have strong analytical and synthesis skills – you are able to distill complex technical risks into clear, actionable insights for management.
• You are an excellent communicator, capable to influence and engage with technical experts, business stakeholders, and external suppliers.
• You are autonomous, proactive, and results-driven with a structured and methodical approach.
• You have strong English professional written and verbal persuasion skills and fluent in French (mandatory) or Dutch.

About this vacancy
As a Senior Data Architect, you are responsible for designing and shaping modern enterprise data platforms that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. • Defining data platform roadmaps, architecture standards, and governance frameworks.
• Leading the design of modern data lakehouse architectures using Databricks.
• Collaborating with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, BI teams, and senior leadership to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
• Defining data modeling strategies for analytical and operational use cases.
• Ensuring data quality, security, compliance, and governance across the data landscape.
• Providing architectural guidance and technical leadership to delivery teams.
• Evaluating emerging technologies and recommending improvements to the data platform ecosystem.
• Documenting architecture decisions, technical standards, and best practices.
What we expect from you
• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Architect, Senior Data Engineer, or in a similar data-focused role.
• Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale data platforms on Microsoft Azure.
• Strong hands-on expertise with Databricks, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Data Workflows, and Lakehouse Architecture.

About this vacancy
As a SharePoint Specialist, you are responsible for ensuring a secure, scalable, and well-governed SharePoint environment that supports collaboration, content management, and business productivity across the organization. Working within the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem, you play a key role in maintaining operational excellence while supporting end users and driving adoption of best practices.

 
Your responsibilities include:
• Administering and configuring SharePoint Online, including site collections, hub sites, permissions, and sharing settings.
• Designing, implementing, and maintaining effective information architectures, including site structures, metadata models, and content types.
• Ensuring SharePoint environments comply with established governance, security, and Microsoft 365 standards.
• Managing access controls and collaboration settings in accordance with corporate IT security policies.
• Supporting business users in the effective use of SharePoint as a collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and document management platform.
• Handling user requests, incidents, and operational support activities related to SharePoint.
• Collaborating with Microsoft 365 specialists to deliver a cohesive and governed digital workplace experience.
• Working alongside Power Platform teams to enable controlled and sustainable citizen development initiatives.
• Supporting integrations with Power BI where SharePoint serves as a data repository or document source.
• Contributing to the full lifecycle management of SharePoint sites, including provisioning, reviews, archiving, and decommissioning.
• Documenting configurations, governance processes, and operational procedures.
What we expect from you
• Minimum 3 years of experience in SharePoint administration, support, or a similar Microsoft 365-focused role.
• Strong hands-on expertise with SharePoint Online and the modern SharePoint experience.
• Solid knowledge of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and Entra ID.
• Proven experience managing permissions, access models, sharing mechanisms, and security configurations.
• Strong understanding of information architecture, content governance, and collaboration best practices.
• Experience working in enterprise-scale or regulated environments.
• Ability to balance operational support, incident management, and continuous platform improvement.
• Familiarity with Power Platform solutions such as Power Apps and Power Automate is considered a plus.
• Experience with Power BI integration scenarios is an advantage.
• Knowledge of records management, retention policies, sensitivity labels, and compliance features is a plus.
• Experience writing and maintaining PowerShell scripts is considered an asset.
• Microsoft 365 and/or SharePoint certifications are highly valued.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.Language requirements
• Professional proficiency in English is mandatory.
• Knowledge of French or Dutch is required.
• Proficiency in English, French, and Dutch is considered a strong advantage.

About this vacancy
As a Business & Process Analyst, you play a pivotal role in bridging business needs, operational processes, and technology solutions. You work closely with stakeholders across the organization to analyze business requirements, optimize processes, and translate needs into clear, actionable deliverables.

This role combines traditional business analysis with process improvement responsibilities. We are looking for someone who is not only an excellent communicator but also highly analytical, comfortable working with complex data, and capable of approaching challenges with a strong quantitative and logical mindset.
Your responsibilities include:
• Gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements from various stakeholders.
• Translating business needs into clear functional specifications and Product Backlog Items (PBIs).
• Writing, maintaining, and refining PBIs to support development and delivery teams.
• Mapping, analyzing, and optimizing end-to-end business processes.
• Identifying inefficiencies, bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Facilitating workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and stakeholder interviews.
• Collaborating closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, developers, and business stakeholders.
• Supporting the implementation of new solutions and ensuring alignment with business objectives.
• Performing data analysis to support decision-making and validate process improvements.
• Defining and documenting business rules, process flows, and functional requirements.
• Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
• Supporting testing activities, acceptance criteria reviews, and solution validation
What we expect from you
• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, or in a combined business/process transformation role.
• Proven experience in both business analysis and process analysis within complex environments.
• Strong experience writing and managing Product Backlog Items (PBIs) and working within Agile delivery frameworks.
• Ability and willingness to actively contribute to backlog management and requirement definition activities.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a structured approach to decision-making.
• Excellent quantitative reasoning skills and the ability to work with data-driven insights.
• A strong affinity with mathematics, logic, process modeling, and analytical thinking.
• Ability to quickly understand complex business challenges and translate them into practical solutions.
